result_text:
`all_files.zip` now takes its entry names from the configured scope aspect names, so renaming an aspect no longer stops it or `git-history.zip` from being written. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a renamed-aspect run.

The change is in `DataExporter.java` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/`. The hard-coded entries for `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt` and the other three are gone. The new code builds each file name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, which is also what writes the loose text files. It reads each file back under that name and uses the same name for the zip entry.

The order is unchanged: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other. With the default configuration the entries are the same five names as before. With the `buildAndDeployment` rename, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the lookup no longer throws, `git-history.zip` is written afterwards when a `git-history.txt` exists.
